name: Slides AI
description:
Slides AI helps you quickly create clear, structured presentations from almost any input. Turn a simple idea, text, PDF, or link into a ready-to-use slide deck in seconds.

The app automatically organizes content into slides, builds layouts, and generates visuals to match your topic. After creation, you can easily refine the presentation using the built-in editor: rewrite text, adjust structure, or customize slides to fit your needs.

Presentations can be exported as fully editable PPTX files or shared as PDFs, making them ready for work, study, or presentations right away.

Key Features

• Flexible input: generate slides from topics, text, PDFs, or URLs
• Automatic slide structuring and layout generation
• 100+ ready-made templates for different presentation styles
• Built-in editor for quick adjustments and full control
• Export to PPTX and PDF formats
• Clean, presentation-ready results in seconds

_published_faq.name: How do I add Slides AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Slides AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.gpt.space/servers/slides-generator/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Slides AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slides AI provides these MCP tools: generate_presentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Slides AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Slides AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Slides AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slides AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Slides AI is developed by Qualtir. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
